Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
MAC.APP. 483/2024 & CM APPL. 53009/2024 (Stay)

1. The instant appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed on behalf of the appellant seeking the following relief:
"a). to allow the appeal and set aside the impugned award dated 24.07.2024 passed by Sh. Shailender Malik, Judge MACT Karkardooma Courts, in MACT No.96/2021,
titled as "Smt. Pushpa Devi & others Vs. Vijay Shankar Kumar & Others", whereby the Appellant is directed to pay Rs.32,04,060/- on account of fatal injuries sustained by the deceased, as compensation along with the interest @ 8% p.a. from the date of institution."

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant submitted that there are several discrepancies in the award dated 24th July, 2024 (hereinafter "impugned award") passed by the learned Tribunal as it failed to appreciate the entirety of the matter as well as the evidence placed on United India Insurance vs Smt Pushpadevi & Ors on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147157635/
1 record.
3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant undertakes to deposit the entire awarded compensation amount as per the direction in the impugned award passed by the learned Tribunal.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of appellant submitted that in the present matter, notice may be issued to the respondents no. 1 to 5 and the notice qua the other respondents may be dispensed with.

5. Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant.
6.
Issue notice of the appeal and the accompanying application to respondents no. 1 to 5 through all permissible modes on filing PF within one week.
7. This Court is, prima facie, satisfied that the matter requires consideration.

Since the matter requires consideration, this Court is inclined to grant the stay on the operation of the impugned award.
8.

Accordingly, subject to the appellant depositing the entire compensation amount along with the interest from the date of the institution of the claim in terms of the impugned award before the Registrar General of this Court within a period of four weeks, the operation of the impugned award shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
The amount so deposited by the appellant shall be invested in an interest bearing FDR in an auto renewal mode.
9. As prayed, notice qua respondents no. 6 and 7 shall be dispensed
